content.title: Think you know what Wi-Fi stands for? Get ready for a surprise
what does fi in wifi mean
what does fi in wifi mean

results:
Interbrand is credited with coming up with the name "Wi-Fi." The Wi-Fi Alliance hired the consultancy because the technical name was hard to remember. Its candidates included a short list of ten names, and Wi-Fi was picked from them.

- **Origin of the request:** The founding members wanted a friendlier name than the technical standard label. Phil Belanger, a founding member, described the request in a Boing Boing post, which also says the group picked Wi-Fi from a list of 10 names Interbrand proposed (the founding members of the Wireless Ethernet Compatibility Alliance, now called the Wi-Fi Alliance, hired Interbrand; the group chose the name Wi-Fi from a list of 10 names that Interbrand proposed).
- **Naming logic:** Interbrand's own website says the technical name would not do, and it wanted something memorable ("The technical term was IEEE 802.11, but that just wouldn't do," Interbrand explains on its website.). The name plays on "Hi-Fi," which listeners already knew (They landed on Wi-Fi, playing off the term Hi-Fi, which everyone was already well familiar with by the late 1990s.).
- **Other Interbrand work:** The same firm's previous credits include the names Prozac and Compaq (Interbrand created "Prozac", "Compaq" "oneworld", "Imation" and many other brand names).
- **The "Wireless Fidelity" myth:** The expansion is not the origin of the name. The alliance briefly used the tagline "The Standard for Wireless Fidelity" alongside the name, and Belanger says it was invented after the fact (This tag line was invented after the fact.). Cory Doctorow of Boing Boing debunked the idea in 2005 (The idea that Wi-Fi actually means "wireless fidelity" has been circulating on the internet since at least 2005).

Most sources here are secondary blogs and news pieces. The Boing Boing post is first-hand from Belanger, and the Interbrand quote comes via Gizmodo Australia. I did not check Interbrand's own site directly.

content.text:
**答案：Interbrand。**

Wi-Fi 联盟(当时叫 Wireless Ethernet Compatibility Alliance)请 Interbrand 为 IEEE 802.11 起一个好记的名字。Interbrand 提出了 10 个候选,联盟选了 Wi-Fi。这个名字借用了当时人人熟悉的 "Hi-Fi"。"Wireless Fidelity" 这个说法是事后补上的口号,不是名字的来源。

我只搜了 1 次。上面的细节出自搜索结果里的摘录,我没有打开原文核对,也没有查 Interbrand 官网。

Sources:

- [Tom's Guide: Think you know what Wi-Fi stands for?](https://www.tomsguide.com/features/think-you-know-what-wi-fi-stands-for-get-ready-for-a-surprise)
- [Gizmodo Australia](https://gizmodo.com.au/?p=1942608)
